desc:
Discover your next favorite look in Catalog Avatar Maker! Try on catalog items, mix and match outfits, and create an avatar that’s uniquely yours.

🛍️ Try on accessories, clothing, hair, limiteds, bundles & more
✨ Mix and match your favorite items to create your perfect outfit
💾 Save your favorite looks and switch up your style anytime
🕺 Try out emotes and animation packs to bring your avatar to life

✅ Avatar items purchased in-game are added directly to your Roblox inventory!
